text: a(n) = n iff n = 1 or n = 10. - _Bernard Schott_, Oct 08 2026
a(n) = Sum_{i=0..n-1} P(i, n-i), where P(x, y) is the number of partitions of x into at most y parts and P(0, y)=1. - _J
a(n) = a(n-1)*(a(n-1)-1) + 1; Sum_{i>=0} 1/a(i) = 1. - _Néstor Romeral Andrés_, Oct 29 2001
a(n) = A000032(3+n) - 1 mod A000045(3+n). - _Mario C. Enriquez_, Apr 01 2017
a(n) = 2*a(n-1) - a(n-4), with a(0)=a(1)=0, a(2)=a(3)=1. - _Vincenzo Librandi_, Dec 20 2010
a(n) = (n-1)! Sum_{k=1..n} a(n-k)/((n-k)! (k-1)!) where a(0)=1. - _Thomas Wieder_, Sep 09 2008
